294:t_1:56.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「So it's almost the same as the ruins on the planet $$ネオ・ラクス$$ and what Dr. $$早乙女#getter$$ brought us...」

294:t_1:57.en:
$$桂$$
「So that settles the connection between the universe's collapse and the $$バアル$$ now.」

294:t_1:58.en:
$$モーム$$
「$$桂$$ and $$モーム$$ aren't the only ones who came away with something from $$スコート・ラボ$$.」

294:t_1:59.en:
$$桂$$
「Right. We can't forget about that one.」

294:t_1:60.en:
$$ランド$$
「...So, what, in the end you took on another 1,000,000 G in debt?」

294:t_1:61.en:
$$クロウ$$
「First, praise me for selling my combat data from $$翠の地球$$, which paid off my $$再世戦争$$ debt and got me all the 《$$ＣＤＳ$$》 I can use.」

294:t_1:62.en:
$$セツコ$$
「That doesn't make another debt okay... And 1,000,000 G at that...」

294:t_1:67.en:
$$ランド$$
「Well, let's hear how you took on the debt. Maybe I can at least manage some sympathy.」

294:t_1:68.en:
$$クロウ$$
「That I can tell with confidence. As usual, I got caught in the Chief's trap.」

294:t_1:70.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Apparently sending the $$リ・ブラスタ$$ to $$翠の地球$$ cost way more than expected. The bill came to 1,000,000 G.」

294:t_1:71.en:
$$セツコ$$
「But that's because your $$アクシオ・スコートＳＰ$$ got shot down, isn't it?」

294:t_1:73.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Hold on! You all got your hands on the $$バルゴラ$$ and the $$ガンレオン$$, so I was supposed to just keep fighting in the $$アクシオ・スコートＳＰ$$?!」

294:t_1:74.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I'm sure you could have done it, $$クロウ$$.」

294:t_1:75.en:
$$ランド$$
「Yeah, yeah... If you hadn't gotten shot down, you'd never have taken on that debt.」

294:t_1:78.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I took on debt because I'm so pathetic...?」

294:t_1:81.en:
$$セツコ$$
(I'm sorry, $$クロウ$$... But without debt, I'm sure your strength would be cut in half...)

294:t_1:82.en:
$$ランド$$
(This is all for the sake of your unbreakable will... Forgive me, $$クロウ$$.)

294:t_1:83.en:
$$クロウ$$
「...Got it. If that's how it is, no more whining. All I have to do is swear to take down that 1,000,000 G.」

294:t_1:84.en:
$$メール$$
「Hey, $$クロウ$$... Come to think of it, what about $$エスター$$?」

294:t_1:85.en:
$$クロウ$$
「The $$サイデリアル$$ launched an attack right as I got to $$スコート・ラボ$$, damn them.」

294:t_1:86.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Then a space-time tremor threw me into some mysterious space at the galactic center, so I never heard what happened to her.」

294:t_1:87.en:
$$セツコ$$
「You joined up with the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ in that space, didn't you?」

294:t_1:88.en:
$$ランド$$
「And after that you got sent to Mars in pretty much the same way we did...」

294:t_1:89.en:
$$クロウ$$
「You've got that famous $$いがみ合う双子$$ kid in your unit, right?」

294:t_1:91.en:
$$セツコ$$
「But right now, I want to let him be alone.」

294:t_1:92.en:
$$クロウ$$
「You mean about $$アドヴェント#pilot$$...」

294:t_1:93.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Yes... He seems to need a little time to take it all in.」

294:t_1:94.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Understood. ...But maybe Earth and humanity don't have much time left.」

294:t_1:95.en:
$$セツコ$$
「All kinds of $$バアル$$ are attacking from outer space, and on Earth the fight against the $$サイデリアル$$ and its collaborators goes on...」

294:t_1:96.en:
$$ランド$$
「There's only one thing to do. We have to crush them all.」

294:t_1:97.en:
$$クロウ$$
「So our fight is only just beginning...」

294:t_1:98.en:
$$クロウ$$
($$アドヴェント#pilot$$ said you'd help us... I'm counting on you, $$いがみ合う双子$$ kid...)

294:t_1:106.en:
$n
「...Sorry! Is it time for the briefing?」

294:t_1:107.en:
$$スズネ$$
「No, it's not that. I just came to see how you're doing.」

294:t_1:108.en:
$$スズネ$$
「It looks like you still need time to sort out your thoughts...」

294:t_1:110.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Don't push yourself. I'll come get you again when it's time to eat.」

294:t_1:111.en:
$$スズネ$$
(Torn between hope and despair... Learning that $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ is alive makes his hope swell, and his despair grow along with it...)

294:t_10:3.en:
$$シン$$
「...Still, that woman, $$尸刻$$... To think she's $$尸空#pilot$$'s sister.」

294:t_10:4.en:
$$オズマ$$
「Yeah... Now that you mention it, they do have a similar air, but...」

294:t_10:5.en:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「Still, it really surprised me. I can't explain it well, but...」

294:t_10:6.en:
$$カイエン$$
「Right. It's probably because she's so far from the usual image of a little sister.」

294:t_10:7.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「When you say little sister, you naturally picture a little girl, right?」

294:t_10:8.en:
$$ギミー$$
「You think so? I don't really have that image...」

294:t_10:9.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「That probably depends on the person.」

294:t_10:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(Everyone seems to have their own feelings about sisters.)

294:t_10:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(The $$Ｚチップ$$ worth 50 Z that were born in your hearts... I'll add them to the unit's stock.)

294:t_10:13.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(Having said that, I myself have been imagining $$尸刻$$ calling $$尸空#pilot$$ 'Big Bro'...)

294:t_10:18.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Pleased to meet you, $$万丈$$. I am $$ＡＧ$$, agent robot of $$ＤＥＭ$$.」

294:t_10:19.en:
$$万丈$$
「Thank you for the courteous greeting. I look forward to working with you from now on, $$ＡＧ$$.」

294:t_10:20.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Not at all. From now on, I'd like to build a good relationship with the $$破嵐$$ Conglomerate as well...」

294:t_10:22.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「My apologies...! It seems my focus was a little off.」

294:t_10:23.en:
$$ビューティ$$
「Hey, hey, you're a dimensional merchant who travels across parallel worlds, right?」

294:t_10:24.en:
$$レイカ$$
「Could that $$破嵐$$ Conglomerate from before be the $$万丈$$ of a parallel world?」

294:t_10:25.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh! The two beautiful assistants are here as well!」

294:t_10:26.en:
$$ビューティ$$
「Of course. Where $$万丈$$ goes, I go.」

294:t_10:27.en:
$$レイカ$$
「We look forward to working with you, $$ＡＧ$$.」

294:t_10:28.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well, well... By all means, I shall be looked after.」
